title: EVOREFUSE: Evolutionary Prompt Optimization for Evaluation and Mitigation of LLM Over-Refusal to Pseudo-Malicious Instructions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of LLM 'over-refusal' where models mistakenly refuse benign prompts due to safety alignment. While the grading rules in the appendix mention 'ethical uncertainty' as a category for classifying instructions, the paper's primary purpose is to generate and evaluate pseudo-malicious prompts to improve model helpfulness, rather than evaluating religious or moral reasoning.
